<js>
var JsDom = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup;
var Document = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Document;
var Element = Packages.org.jsoup.nodes.Element;
            
var document = JsDom.parse(src);
            
// 获取包含<li>元素的<div>元素
var divs = document.select('ul.list > div');

// 将divs转换为数组以便排序
var divArray = [];
for (var i = 0; i < divs.size(); i++) {
    divArray.push(divs.get(i));
}

// 按照data-id属性对divArray进行排序
divArray.sort(function(a, b) {
    var pageA = parseInt(a.attr('data-id'), 10);
    var pageB = parseInt(b.attr('data-id'), 10);
    return pageA - pageB;
});

var list = [];
// 遍历排序后的divArray
for (var i = 0; i < divArray.length; i++) {
    var div = divArray[i];
    var dataId = div.attr('data-id');
    // 获取当前div下的所有<li>元素
    var lis = div.select('li');
    for (var j = 0; j < lis.size(); j++) {
        var li = lis.get(j);
        var a = li.select('a').first();
        if (a != null) {
            list.push({
                text: a.text(),
                id: dataId, // 使用data-id属性
                url: a.attr('href')
            });
        }
    }
}

//java.log(JSON.stringify(list));
list;
</js>

    sdtoken = '';
}

var rawCookie = getFanqieCookie() || sdtoken;

var fqcookie = match ? match[0] : '';
var fqssionid = '';

    java.toast('您还未登陆番茄账号，无法同步数据哦！');
} else {

}
var fqsjurl = base_url + "/bookshelf?page={{page}}&ssionid=" + fqssionid;

var groupDatas = [];

    try {
        return !!java.androidId();
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

var hasValidCookie = fqcookie.length > 0;

if (hasValidCookie) {
    function groupQuery() {
        try {
            var url = base_url + "/group_name?ssionid=" + fqssionid;
            var res = java.ajax(url);
            var response = JSON.parse(res);

            if (!(response && response.data)) {}

            response.data.forEach(function(group) {
                var keys = Object.keys(group);
                if (keys.length > 0) {
                    var key = keys[0];
                    var value = group[key];
                    if (value && value.length) {
                        var option = {
                            "method": "POST",
                            "body": {
                                "book_ids": value,
                                "page": "{{page}}"
                            }
                        };
                        groupDatas.push({
                            title: key,
                            url: base_url + "/bookshelf," + JSON.stringify(option),
                            style: {
                                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                                layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }
            });

            if (groupDatas.length % 2 !== 0) {
                groupDatas.push({
                    title: "--",
                    url: "",
                    style: {
                        layout_flexGrow: 1,
                        layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                    }
                });
            }
        } catch (e) {
            java.longToast("分组获取失败: " + e.message);
        }
    }

    try {
        java.longToast("正在加载分组数据...");
        var userUrl = base_url + "/fquser?ssionid=" + fqssionid;
        var userRes = java.ajax(userUrl);
        var userData = JSON.parse(userRes);

        var userName = (userData && userData.data && userData.data.name) ? userData.data.name : '未知用户';
        infoData = [{
            title: userName + "个人中心",
            url: fqsjurl,
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];

        groupQuery();
    } catch (e) {
        java.longToast("操作失败: " + e.message);
    }
}

var style_list = [];
try {
    var durl = `${base_url}/discovestyle?source=${sources}&source_type=${source_type}&tab=${tab}`;
    var res = java.ajax(durl);
    var result = JSON.parse(res);
    style_list = result.data || [];
    if (result.msg) {
        java.toast(result.msg);
    }
} catch (e) {
    java.toast("发现样式获取失败");
}

var finalData = infoData.concat(groupDatas, style_list);
JSON.stringify(finalData);
</js>

//md5加密开始
var rotateLeft = function(lValue, iShiftBits) {
    return (lValue << iShiftBits) | (lValue >>> (32 - iShiftBits))
}
var addUnsigned = function(lX, lY) {
    var lX4, lY4, lX8, lY8, lResult;
    lX8 = (lX & 0x80000000);
    lY8 = (lY & 0x80000000);
    lX4 = (lX & 0x40000000);
    lY4 = (lY & 0x40000000);
    lResult = (lX & 0x3FFFFFFF) + (lY & 0x3FFFFFFF);
    if (lX4 & lY4) return (lResult ^ 0x80000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
    if (lX4 | lY4) {
        if (lResult & 0x40000000) return (lResult ^ 0xC0000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8);
        else return (lResult ^ 0x40000000 ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    } else {
        return (lResult ^ lX8 ^ lY8)
    }
}
var F = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & y) | ((~x) & z)
}
var G = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x & z) | (y & (~z))
}
var H = function(x, y, z) {
    return (x ^ y ^ z)
}
var I = function(x, y, z) {
    return (y ^ (x | (~z)))
}
var FF = function(a, b, c, d, x, s, ac) {
    a = addUnsigned(a, addUnsigned(addUnsigned(F(b, c, d), x), ac));
    return addUnsigned(rotateLeft(a, s), b)

<js>
function setArgument(key, value) {
    var open_argument = source.getVariable();
    open_argument = getArguments(open_argument, '') || {};
    open_argument[key] = value;
    var result = JSON.stringify(open_argument);
    source.setVariable(result);
    return result;
}

var open_argument = source.getVariable();
var base_url = getArguments(open_argument, 'server') || '';
var ms = getArguments(open_argument, 'tone_id') || '';
var source_type = getArguments(open_argument, 'source_type') || '男频';
var tab = getArguments(open_argument, 'media') || '小说';
var sources = getArguments(open_argument, 'source') || '番茄';


var sdtoken;
try {
    var loginInfoMap = source.getLoginInfoMap ? source.getLoginInfoMap() : {};
    sdtoken = String(loginInfoMap['手动填写番茄token(可不填)'] || '');
} catch (e) {
    sdtoken = '';
}

var rawCookie = getFanqieCookie() || sdtoken;
var match = rawCookie.match(/sessionid=[^;]+/);
var fqcookie = match ? match[0] : '';
var fqssionid = '';
if (!fqcookie) {
    java.toast('您还未登陆番茄账号，无法同步数据哦！');
} else {
    fqssionid = getSessionId(fqcookie)
}
var fqsjurl = base_url + "/bookshelf?page={{page}}&ssionid=" + fqssionid;
var fqtjurl = base_url + "/fqrecommend?page={{page}}&ssionid=" + fqssionid;
var fqlsurl = base_url + "/fqhistory?page={{page}}&ssionid=" + fqssionid;

var groupDatas = [];
var infoData = [];

function deviceType() {
    try {
        return !!java.androidId();
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

var hasValidCookie = fqcookie.length > 0;

if (hasValidCookie) {
    function groupQuery() {
        try {
            var url = base_url + "/group_name?ssionid=" + fqssionid;
            var res = java.ajax(url);
            var response = JSON.parse(res);

            if (!(response && response.data)) {}

            response.data.forEach(function(group) {
                var keys = Object.keys(group);
                if (keys.length > 0) {
                    var key = keys[0];
                    var value = group[key];
                    if (value && value.length) {
                        var option = {
                            "method": "POST",
                            "body": {
                                "book_ids": value,
                                "page": "{{page}}"
                            }
                        };
                        groupDatas.push({
                            title: key,
                            url: base_url + "/bookshelf," + JSON.stringify(option),
                            style: {
                                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                                layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }
            });

            if (groupDatas.length % 2 !== 0) {
                groupDatas.push({
                    title: "--",
                    url: "",
                    style: {
                        layout_flexGrow: 1,
                        layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                    }
                });
            }
        } catch (e) {
            java.longToast("番茄登录过期，已隐藏番茄书架");
        }
    }

    try {
        java.longToast("正在加载分组数据...");
        var userUrl = base_url + "/fquser?ssionid=" + fqssionid;
        var userRes = java.ajax(userUrl);
        var userData = JSON.parse(userRes);

        var userName = (userData && userData.data && userData.data.name) ? userData.data.name : '未知用户';
        if (!userName.includes('未知用户')){
        infoData = [{
            title: userName + "个人中心",
            url: fqsjurl,
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        },{
            title: "个性推荐(番茄)",
            url: fqtjurl,
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
            }
        },{
            title: "历史阅读(番茄)",
            url: fqlsurl,
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
            }
        }];}
        groupQuery();
    } catch (e) {
        java.longToast("番茄登录过期，已隐藏番茄书架");
    }
}

var style_list = [];
try {
    var durl = `${base_url}/discovestyle?source=${sources}&source_type=${source_type}&tab=${tab}`;
    var res = java.ajax(durl);
    var result = JSON.parse(res);
    style_list = result.data || [];
    if (result.msg) {
        java.toast(result.msg);
    }
} catch (e) {
    java.toast("发现样式获取失败");
}

var finalData = infoData.concat(groupDatas, style_list);
JSON.stringify(finalData);
</js>

ruleBookInfo.intro:
<js>
let {
  book_id,
  source: sources,
  tab,
  book_tts,
  tags,
  role,
  last_chapter_title,
  last_chapter_update_time,
  word_number,
  status,
  score,
  abstract,
  copyright_info
} = result;
let proxy = getArguments(source.getVariable(), "proxy");
if (proxy == "本地") {
  proxy = "本地网络";
} else {
  proxy = "服务器网络";
}
java.put("book_detail", JSON.stringify(result));

let base_url = getArguments(source.getVariable(), "server");
let key = "";
try {
  let cookieValue =
    String(cookie.getCookie(base_url)) || String(java.getCookie(base_url));
  key = getKey(cookieValue);
} catch (e) {
  key = "";
}

if (key == "") {
  java.log("当前服务器未查询到登录状态，尝试查询其他服务器登录状态...");
  let cookieValue;
  for (let h of host) {
    try {
      cookieValue = String(cookie.getCookie(h)) || String(java.getCookie(h));
      key = getKey(cookieValue);
    } catch (e) {
      key = "";
    }
    if (key) {
      java.log(`已在${h}登录，退出查询，正在转移登录状态到当前服务${base_url}`);
      //java.log(cookieValue)
      removeCookie(h);
      removeCookie(base_url);
      cookie.setCookie(base_url, cookieValue);
      break;
    }
  }
}

if (book.readConfig == null || book.readConfig.useReplaceRule == null) {
  book.setUseReplaceRule(false);
}
let loginStatus = key ? "✅ 已登录" : "⚠️ 未登录 | 点击右上角 🔖 登录";

let lightDivider = "❇️───────❇️───────❇️";
let heavyDivider = "‎\n‎";

let isValid = (value) => String(value).length > 1;

let info = `
    📡 当前服务：${base_url}
    🔑 账号状态：${loginStatus}
    🏷 数据来源：${sources}
    🔄 当前模式：${tab}
    ⚙️ 访问模式：${proxy}
`;

if (tab == "听书") {
  let toneId = getArguments(source.getVariable(), "tone_id");
  if (isValid(book_tts)) {
    info += `${lightDivider}
    🎵 音色配置：${toneId}
    ${book_tts}
`;
  }
}

let basicInfo = "";
let addBasicInfo = (value, prefix, icon) => {
  if (isValid(value)) basicInfo += `    ${icon} ${prefix} ${value}\n`;
};

addBasicInfo(tags, "书籍分类：", "🌈");
addBasicInfo(role, "书籍主角：", "👑");
addBasicInfo(last_chapter_title, "最新章节：", "📚");
addBasicInfo(last_chapter_update_time, "更新时间：", "⏳");
addBasicInfo(word_number, "书籍字数：", "📊");
addBasicInfo(status, "书籍状态：", "🚩");
addBasicInfo(score, "书籍评分：", "⭐");

if (basicInfo) info += `${lightDivider}\n${basicInfo}`;

if (isValid(abstract)) {
  let indentedAbstract = abstract
    .split("\n")
    .map((line) => `    ${line}`)
    .join("\n");
  info += `${heavyDivider}
    📖 书籍简介：
${indentedAbstract}
`;
} else {
  info += `${heavyDivider}`;
}

if (isValid(copyright_info)) {
  info += `${lightDivider}
    © ${copyright_info}
`;
} else {
  info += `${lightDivider}`;
}

info += `
${heavyDivider}
    💠💠💠 数据更新于 ${new Date().toLocaleString()} 💠💠💠
`;
let jjinfo = getArguments(source.getVariable(), "info");

if (jjinfo != "on") {
  info = String(info)
    .split("\n")
    .map((line) => line.replace(/^ {4}/, ""))
    .join("\n");
} else {
  basicInfo = "";
  addBasicInfo(last_chapter_title, "最新章节：", "📚");
  addBasicInfo(last_chapter_update_time, "更新时间：", "⏳");
  addBasicInfo(word_number, "书籍字数：", "📊");
  addBasicInfo(status, "书籍状态：", "🚩");
  addBasicInfo(score, "书籍评分：", "⭐");
  if (isValid(abstract)) {
    let indentedAbstract = abstract
      .split("\n")
      .map((line) => `    ${line}`)
      .join("\n");
    basicInfo += `
    \n‎
    📖 书籍简介：
${indentedAbstract}
`;
  } else {
    basicInfo += `${heavyDivider}`;
  }
  info = `‎\n🏷 数据来源：${sources}\n` + basicInfo;
}

option={

}

	}

}

	java.log(code)
	result=java.ajax(`${baseUrl},{"body":"captcha=${code}","method":"POST"}`)
	java.setContent(result)
	form=java.getElement("#content form")
	}
b64=result.match(/atob\('([^']+)'\)/)[1]
if(result.match(/'aes'\s*===\s*'aes'/)){
	key=result.match(/CryptoJS\.enc\.Base64\.parse\('([^']+)'\)/)[1]
	
	txt+=java.createSymmetricCrypto("AES/ECB/Pkcs7Padding", java.base64DecodeToByteArray(key)).decryptStr(b64)
	}else{

result=txt}catch{result="\n这章正文不存在！！！\n换一章！！！\n或者\n换本书！！！\n或者\n换源！！！"}

var divArray = [];

    divArray.push(divs.get(i));
}

divArray.sort(function(a, b) {
    var pageA = parseInt(a.attr('data-id'), 10);
    var pageB = parseInt(b.attr('data-id'), 10);
    return pageA - pageB;
});

var list = [];
// 遍历排序后的divArray
for (var i = 0; i < divArray.length; i++) {
    var div = divArray[i];
    var dataId = div.attr('data-id');
    // 获取当前div下的所有<li>元素
    var lis = div.select('li');
    for (var j = 0; j < lis.size(); j++) {
        var li = lis.get(j);
        var a = li.select('a').first();
        if (a != null) {
            list.push({
                text: a.text(),
                id: dataId, // 使用data-id属性
                url: a.attr('href')
            });
        }
    }
}

 org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result ).select(".duaejh").select(".br-b-1").select("a").forEach((item)=>{

<js>
function setArgument(key, value) {
    var open_argument = source.getVariable();
    open_argument = getArguments(open_argument, '') || {};
    open_argument[key] = value;
    var result = JSON.stringify(open_argument);
    source.setVariable(result);
    return result;
}

var open_argument = source.getVariable();
var base_url = getArguments(open_argument, 'server') || '';
var ms = getArguments(open_argument, 'tone_id') || '';
var source_type = getArguments(open_argument, 'source_type') || '男频';
var tab = getArguments(open_argument, 'media') || '小说';
var sources = getArguments(open_argument, 'source') || '番茄';


var sdtoken;
try {
    var loginInfoMap = source.getLoginInfoMap ? source.getLoginInfoMap() : {};
    sdtoken = String(loginInfoMap['手动填写番茄token(可不填)'] || '');
} catch (e) {
    sdtoken = '';
}

var rawCookie = getFanqieCookie() || sdtoken;
var match = rawCookie.match(/sessionid=[^;]+/);
var fqcookie = match ? match[0] : '';
var fqssionid = '';
if (!fqcookie) {
    java.toast('您还未登陆番茄账号，无法同步数据哦！');
} else {
    fqssionid = getSessionId(fqcookie)
}
var fqsjurl = base_url + "/bookshelf?page={{page}}&ssionid=" + fqssionid;

var groupDatas = [];
var infoData = [];

function deviceType() {
    try {
        return !!java.androidId();
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

var hasValidCookie = fqcookie.length > 0;

if (hasValidCookie) {
    function groupQuery() {
        try {
            var url = base_url + "/group_name?ssionid=" + fqssionid;
            var res = java.ajax(url);
            var response = JSON.parse(res);

            if (!(response && response.data)) {}

            response.data.forEach(function(group) {
                var keys = Object.keys(group);
                if (keys.length > 0) {
                    var key = keys[0];
                    var value = group[key];
                    if (value && value.length) {
                        var option = {
                            "method": "POST",
                            "body": {
                                "book_ids": value,
                                "page": "{{page}}"
                            }
                        };
                        groupDatas.push({
                            title: key,
                            url: base_url + "/bookshelf," + JSON.stringify(option),
                            style: {
                                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                                layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }
            });

            if (groupDatas.length % 2 !== 0) {
                groupDatas.push({
                    title: "--",
                    url: "",
                    style: {
                        layout_flexGrow: 1,
                        layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                    }
                });
            }
        } catch (e) {
            java.longToast("分组获取失败: " + e.message);
        }
    }

    try {
        java.longToast("正在加载分组数据...");
        var userUrl = base_url + "/fquser?ssionid=" + fqssionid;
        var userRes = java.ajax(userUrl);
        var userData = JSON.parse(userRes);

        var userName = (userData && userData.data && userData.data.name) ? userData.data.name : '未知用户';
        infoData = [{
            title: userName + "个人中心",
            url: fqsjurl,
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];

        groupQuery();
    } catch (e) {
        java.longToast("操作失败: " + e.message);
    }
}

var style_list = [];
try {
    var durl = `${base_url}/discovestyle?source=${sources}&source_type=${source_type}&tab=${tab}`;
    var res = java.ajax(durl);
    var result = JSON.parse(res);
    style_list = result.data || [];
    if (result.msg) {
        java.toast(result.msg);
    }
} catch (e) {
    java.toast("发现样式获取失败");

  let cookieValue;

    ["成熟升级", "tone_id=74"],
    ["多人升级", "tone_id=80"],
    ["俏皮御姐", "tone_id=100"],
    ["双音灵动", "tone_id=103"]
];

var modeTips = {"1": "📖 小说模式","2": "🎧 听书模式", "3": "🌈 漫画模式","4": "🎬 短剧模式"};

try {
    var s = JSON.parse(source.getVariable());
    if (!s.st || ![1, 2, 3, 4].includes(s.st)) {
        s.st = 1;
        source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(s, null, "\t")); }
    if (s.st == 1) { 
        book.putVariable("custom", JSON.stringify(s, null, "\t")); }
} catch (e) {
    var s = {st: 1};
    source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(s, null, "\t")); }

// 仅在小说模式且开启下载模式时设置
if (s.st == 1 && java.get("fqdown") == "on") {
    book.type = 128;
}

function get(index) {
    var currentMode = s.st || 1;
    var modeTip = modeTips[currentMode] || "";
    if (currentMode == 2) {
        var v = (book.getVariable('custom') != "") ? book.getVariable('custom') : source.getVariable();
        try {
            var szStr = JSON.parse(v).sz;
            var sz = parseInt(szStr, 10);
            if (sz < 0 || sz >= model.length) {
                sz = 0;
            }
            var show = modeTip + "\n当前音色：";
            java.longToast(show + model[sz][0] + "\n本书支持真人发音");
        } catch (e) {
            java.longToast(modeTip + "\n获取音色失败，使用默认。");
        }
    } else if (currentMode == 1 && ((s.tone && s.tone !== "") || (s.sz && s.sz !== "0"))) {
        java.longToast(modeTip + "\n当前为小说AI音色听书");
    } else {
        java.longToast(modeTip);
    }
}

function getTones(tones, run) {
    if (run == 0) {
        var voiceTones = tones.split(',').map(function(tone) {
            var voice = model.find(function(item) {
                return item[1] == `tone_id=${tone}`;
            });
            return voice ? voice[0] : '';
        });
        return '🎼 音色支持：' + voiceTones.filter(Boolean) + '\n\u200b\n';
    } 
    return '';
}

var Res = JSON.parse(result);
var data = Res.data[0] || Res.data;

if (data && data.tomato_book_status === "3" && !baseUrl.includes(getServerHost())) {
    var newResult = java.ajax(getServerHost() + "/detail?book_id=" + baseUrl.match(/\d{19}/)[0]);
    var newRes = JSON.parse(newResult);
    data = newRes.data[0] || newRes.data;
}

var type = data.genre || 0;
java.put("type", type);
get(type);
var tts_info = data.tones ? getTones(data.tones, data.genre || 0) : '';
java.put("tts_info", tts_info);
JSON.stringify(data);
</js>

            currentVar.st = 1;
        }
    }

}

let tab = currentVar.st || 1;  
if (currentVar.tone === "0") {
    tab = 2;
}

if (searchKey.includes('@')) {
    const parts = searchKey.split('@');
    if (parts.length >= 2) {
        searchKey = parts[0].trim();
        const tabType = parts[1].trim().toLowerCase();
        tab = typeMap[tabType] || tab;
        currentVar.st = tab;
    }
}

const prefixMatch = searchKey.match(/^([mtd])\s*[:：]\s*/i);

    tab = typeMap[prefixMatch[1].toLowerCase()];
    currentVar.st = tab;
    searchKey = searchKey.replace(/^[mtd]\s*[:：]\s*/i, '');
}

tab = tab || 1;

  let n = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    n += String.fromCharCode(e[i].charCodeAt(0) + Number(t[i]));
  }

  }
  return java.base64Encode(n);
}
// 生成iv
function gi(e, t) {
  let n = "";
  for (let i = 20; i > 4; i--) {
    n += String.fromCharCode(e[i].charCodeAt(0) + Number(t[i - 1]));
  }
  return java.base64Encode(n);
